task.title: Implement Tailscale Serve setup, verified identity/grants, and fail-closed transport middleware

sourceEvidence.observed: Serve removes spoofable incoming Tailscale identity headers before adding authenticated identity and app-capability headers; the backend should remain loopback-only.
Persistent Serve configuration uses --bg and is explicitly disabled with tailscale serve off.
App capabilities are requester-specific authorization data delivered to the application per request.
Default tailnet reachability is not application authorization; the transport requires the exact control app capability.
Enabling HTTPS publishes the machine name through certificate transparency, so setup reports a non-sensitive-name warning before enablement.

setupControls.stableEndpoint: derived from the local running node DNSName as an exact HTTPS origin
setupControls.reason: Self.CapMap is local-node state, not authoritative requester-specific grant evidence. The exact Serve-injected app-capability header is parsed and authorized on every request.

transportControls: The backend origin must parse as the exact loopback broker endpoint.
Direct ingress and direct Tailscale identity-header spoof attempts fail closed.
Tailscale login must parse exactly and match the login derived from local status.
The app-capability header must contain exactly the control capability with one empty parameter object and no unrelated capabilities.
Host and required Origin must match the stable Serve HTTPS origin.
The same requiresOrigin guard applies to browser API and WebSocket upgrade requests.
No Basic, JWT, local-browser credential, default-allow network, or malformed-state fallback exists.

securityReview.modelVisibility: The subagent tool did not expose a model identifier; the active GPT-5.6 Sol executor performed the remediation and final verification directly.
securityReview.initialVerdict: No Critical or High findings; one Medium Self.CapMap authority finding and one Low integration-wiring residual.
resolvedFindings: Removed requester grant readiness checks from Self.CapMap.
Added grantVerification=per_request to ready setup state.
Added a red-green regression proving forged or non-empty control data in Self.CapMap cannot establish or deny requester authorization.
Retained strict exact capability parsing at the trusted per-request boundary.
securityReview.remainingFinding: Low: Todo 10 must bind trusted_proxy ingress metadata to the actual Serve-only listener/path; a future integration must not label arbitrary direct traffic trusted.
securityReview.finalVerdict: No unresolved Critical, High, or Medium Todo 9 finding.
